scope.note: This is about TILL, not about your Mac. Your mail app uses the internet; that is how your mail arrives.

setup.prompt: Turn off your wifi, then press Check now.
setup.passed: TILL wrote a draft with your wifi off.

missing.local_runtime: Install the local drafting engine (Writing style)
missing.draftable_thread: An unanswered message TILL can reply to (Correspondence)

setup.incomplete: The check could not finish. Nothing was sent.

limits.title: What this does not cover
limits.os: Backups and cloud sync (iCloud, Time Machine) can copy your mail off this Mac. TILL cannot see or prevent that.
limits.machine: If this Mac is compromised, none of this holds.
limits.disk: Encryption at rest is FileVault's job. Turn it on.
limits.sockets: The standing indicator watches network sockets only (TCP, UDP, DNS). The self-test you run on demand is what also covers subprocesses and higher layers (TLS, HTTP, fetch, WebSocket).
limits.trust_us: This indicator is our software. The check with your wifi off is the one you do not have to take our word for.

violated.report: This is a bug. Please report it.

model_download.note: Installing the drafting engine downloads the model once. After that it never connects again.

egress.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to see the offline proof.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics & feedback
diagnostics.scope: These settings and files belong to this computer account, not to a workspace. Anyone who can use this account can read them.

capture.label: Record error details on this computer
capture.hint: Off by default. Turning it off again deletes what has already been recorded.

captured.title: What gets recorded
captured.list: The error code, which action failed, which kind of screen you were on, the time, the name of our source file, the function and line, and the names (not the contents) of the fields involved.
captured.never: Never: amounts, names, account numbers, anything you typed, any error text, or which record you had open.

diagnostics.at_rest: TILL does not encrypt these files. On a Mac, FileVault is what protects them.

empty.off: TILL is not recording error details.
empty.on: No errors recorded since you turned this on.

confirm.title: Delete the recorded errors?
confirm.body: This deletes the error list. Reports you already wrote are kept.

error.config_not_writable: TILL could not write to {path}, so the setting stays off.
error.config_unreadable: The settings file could not be read, so defaults apply. The file was left as it is.
error.journal_not_readable: The recorded errors could not be read from {path}. Clear now removes that file and starts over.

denied.body: You do not have permission to read recorded error details. You can still delete them: erasing your own data never requires one.

log.title: Reports you wrote
log.cannot_confirm: TILL hands a report to your email app and cannot tell whether you sent it.
log.empty: You have not written a report yet.

location.local: Your books: one single file on this device ({path}). Nothing leaves TILL by itself.
location.served: Your books: one file on this instance; export and backup at any time.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.model: One ledger, one instance. Every additional person and device works as a client of it. No device sync.

local.label: Local
local.hint: This device. No sharing, no server.

selfhost.label: Self-hosted
selfhost.hint: One Docker image, one command (docker compose up -d), behind your own reverse proxy.

managed.label: Managed
managed.hint: Your own instance, your own URL, Swiss hosting.
managed.moreBody: The managed instance is provisioned outside of TILL, as an external step. It is not available yet.

hosting.denied: Only someone who may manage settings can run a move.
hosting.done: Move complete: {name} is retired here. This device works as a client of the {target} instance.

step.2_selfhost: Set up the instance: docker compose up -d (guide, manual)
step.2_local: Install TILL on the target device (manual)
step.3: Restore the backup there (restore dialog on first start, manual)
step.manual_note: TILL cannot verify the manual steps on the other machine; you confirm them yourself, and step 4's comparison is the one check this panel offers.

compare.note: Manual comparison: TILL cannot read the other instance. Open its trial balance there and compare the total.
compare.mismatchBody: The totals differ: the target instance restored a different backup.
compare.mismatchAction: Create the backup again and transfer it; steps 1, 3 and 4 are open again.

stale.notice: This ledger was moved but is still writable.

retire.title: Retire ledger
retire.body: {name} becomes read-only on this device. The books stay intact and exportable. Reactivate it any time from the client roster.
retire.denied: This needs the manage settings permission (manage_settings).

steps.1: Create a backup and an export here
steps.2: Restore at home (or on your own server) via the restore dialog on first start
steps.4: Close the account with the provider (external)

backup.restorePath: Restorable on any TILL install via the restore dialog on first start. Schema generation {generation}.

Operations.title: Operations
Operations.body:
This is where the panels you visit during day-to-day operation live, rather than during setup: the offline proof (Vertrauen), the runtime line, sync and hosting, data and backup, the roster of your mandates, and diagnostics and feedback.

Each panel appears only once a workspace is selected, and most of them need a permission of their own. The company profile itself stays under Setup.

verify.unbalanced: Checked, but not balanced: {entries} entries. Do not restore this backup.
